title: trainmeet.catalog-1.batch

BatchCard.description: One photo of a batch: a draft of one vehicle, not a vehicle (CAT-147, CAT-148).

position.description: The order the photos came in, and are read in.
position.title: Position

version.description: Raised by every change of the values, also by the AI's. A change and Godkänn alla carry the version seen, so nothing unseen is saved (CAT-136).
version.title: Version

values.description: What the vehicle becomes when it is approved: the AI's suggestions, and then what the owner writes.

suggestions.description: What the AI suggested, as for one reading.
suggestions.title: Suggestions

message.description: Why the card is as it is, in Swedish: such as why the reading failed, or that the tokens ran out (CAT-152).
message.title: Message

picture.description: The photo, without metadata, at most 1800 pixels: signed addresses that expire (CAT-130). Null once approved: the vehicle has it then.

attempts.description: How many times the AI has been asked to read it.
attempts.title: Attempts

prototype.description: A reviewed prototype whose litt and operator match the card's values (CAT-141), looked up when the card is read. Linked only when the owner says so, once the card is a vehicle (CAT-136).

BatchCard.title: BatchCard

BatchCardStatus.description: Where a photo of a batch is (CAT-147–CAT-153).
BatchCardStatus.title: BatchCardStatus

Confidence.description: The AI's own judgement, not a probability.
Confidence.title: Confidence

DccFunction.description: A locomotive's function: F0 light, F2 horn ... (CAT-66).
DccFunction.title: DccFunction

PictureLinks.description:
The vehicle's main picture, for the lists and the card (CAT-125). Signed addresses that
expire (CAT-130): read the vehicle again for new ones.

display_url.description: The display picture, at most 1800 pixels (CAT-126).
display_url.title: Display Url

PictureLinks.title: PictureLinks

PrototypeSummary.description: A prototype in short: what a suggestion names (CAT-141).

revision.description: The reviewed revision, the version a link would get.
revision.title: Revision

PrototypeSummary.title: PrototypeSummary

ReadingQuestion.description: An uncertain digit, asked of the owner (CAT-140).

options.description: The number as painted, with the digit that was uncertain filled in so that the EVN's check digit adds up.
options.title: Options

ReadingQuestion.title: ReadingQuestion

Suggestion.description: A value the AI suggests for a core field. Never saved before the owner has seen it.

value.description: As for the field: kind is a VehicleKind; the number as painted, with ? for a character that could not be read (CAT-138).
value.title: Value

evidence.description: Where in the photo it stands, in the AI's words.
evidence.title: Evidence

Suggestion.title: Suggestion

VehicleFields.description:
The core fields the owner writes (CAT-53). The pictures and the tag have addresses of
their own; the prototype comes later.

number.description: As painted: leading zeros, spaces, dashes kept.
number.title: Number

operator.description: The operator as text. No logos (CAT-61).
operator.title: Operator

note.description: Private. Never in a mini card or an export to others (CAT-191).
note.title: Note

dcc_address.description: Locomotives and multiple units: the DCC address as text.
dcc_address.title: Dcc Address

VehicleFields.title: VehicleFields

VehicleStatus.description: A draft, or ready: ready needs a kind and a litt or number (CAT-62).
VehicleStatus.title: VehicleStatus

description: A batch of photos and its cards (CAT-147).

ai.description: The photos are read with AI; else they are filled in by hand.
ai.title: Ai

mine.description: The person asking made the batch.
mine.title: Mine

cards.description: In order. Someone who edits the fleet sees only the cards not approved.
cards.title: Cards

waiting_until.description: The queue waits for the hour's limit or the day's cap, and goes on by itself then (CAT-146).
waiting_until.title: Waiting Until

message.description: Why the queue waits, in Swedish.
message.title: Message

already.description: Only in the answer to POST: the cards that photos sent this time already were, in this batch or another, since the same file is never two drafts (CAT-149).
already.title: Already
